role: Actual official web primary checks for changed/retained scientific boundaries, read during this independent turn; paraphrases only

sources.title: NHGRI Gene Therapy
sources.usedFor: Gene addition/replacement and distinct editing approaches; a delivered DNA sequence alone is not clinical effectiveness.

sources.title: NHGRI How is Genome Editing Used?
sources.usedFor: Somatic non-reproductive cells; delivery to the right target cells and unintended edits are distinct efficacy/safety problems.

sources.title: NIH Targeted Genome Editor Delivery Challenge
sources.usedFor: Tissue/cell-specific delivery in sufficient quantities is a real separate constraint; retinal/skin classroom change is genuine transfer.

sources.title: NCI What Is Cancer?
sources.usedFor: Cell regulation and uncontrolled growth differ from tissue invasion, blood/lymph transport and secondary tumor formation.

sources.title: HFEA PGT-M and PGT-SR
sources.usedFor: Embryo genetic testing before transfer answers a specific target question. This UK scientific method check is not a German-law claim; classroom ruleR stays fictional.

sources.title: WHO Global assessment of endocrine disruptors
sources.usedFor: Endocrine disruption is functional perturbation that can lead to adverse outcomes, so receptor binding alone does not establish the adverse endpoint.
